quotas.name: Authorizations per DB security group
quotas.description: Number of security group authorizations per DB security group

quotas.name: Custom endpoints per DB cluster
quotas.description: The maximum number of custom endpoints that you can create per Aurora DB cluster in this account in the current Region. This value reflects the highest number of custom endpoints in a DB cluster in the account. Other DB clusters in the account might have a lower number of custom endpoints.

quotas.name: Custom engine versions
quotas.description: The maximum number of custom engine versions allowed in this account in the current Region

quotas.name: DB cluster parameter groups
quotas.description: The maximum number of DB cluster parameter groups

quotas.description: The maximum number of Aurora clusters allowed in this account in the current Region

quotas.name: DB instances
quotas.default: ap-south-1: 20; Each of the other supported Regions: 40
quotas.description: The maximum number of DB instances allowed in this account in the current Region

quotas.name: DB shard groups
quotas.description: The maximum number of DB shard groups for Aurora Limitless Database in this account in the current Region

quotas.name: DB subnet groups
quotas.default: ap-south-1: 20; Each of the other supported Regions: 50
quotas.description: The maximum number of DB subnet groups

quotas.name: Data API HTTP request body size
quotas.description: The maximum size allowed for the HTTP request body.

quotas.name: Data API maximum concurrent cluster-secret pairs
quotas.description: The maximum number of unique pairs of Aurora Serverless v1 DB clusters and secrets in concurrent Data API requests for this account in the current AWS Region.

quotas.name: Data API maximum concurrent requests
quotas.description: The maximum number of Data API requests to an Aurora Serverless v1 DB cluster that use the same secret and can be processed at the same time. Additional requests are queued and processed as in-process requests complete.

quotas.name: Data API maximum result set size
quotas.description: The maximum size of the database result set that can be returned by the Data API.

quotas.name: Data API maximum size of JSON response string
quotas.description: The maximum size of the simplified JSON response string returned by the RDS Data API.

quotas.name: Data API requests per second
quotas.description: The maximum number of requests to the Data API per second allowed for this account in the current AWS Region. This quota only applies to Amazon Aurora Serverless v1 clusters.

quotas.name: Event subscriptions
quotas.description: The maximum number of event subscriptions

quotas.name: IAM roles per DB cluster
quotas.description: The maximum number of IAM roles associated with a DB cluster

quotas.name: IAM roles per DB instance
quotas.description: The maximum number of IAM roles associated with a DB instance

quotas.name: Integrations
quotas.description: The maximum number of integrations allowed in this account in the current AWS Region

quotas.name: Manual DB cluster snapshots
quotas.description: The maximum number of manual DB cluster snapshots
